### Borea v0.5.0-dev.1: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.5.0 before it is released.
It is not for users. For normal use, stay on v0.4.0.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- Scrolling and animations: scroll long pages with the mouse wheel, hover over buttons and open dropdown menus. Scrolling should glide, and nothing should stutter, flicker or jump.
- Modpacks: make an instance from a pack, open the pack's Mods tab, and use "Use <newer>" on a member, then "Back to <version>". Check that the table lines up and that "Installed <version>" shows how that version fits your game.
- Discover: an installed mod or pack should be easy to spot, with a green check and an "Installed" chip.
- Narrow windows and German: open mod and pack pages in a narrow window. No button should be cut off, and the title should break only between words.

#### New since v0.4.0

- Smooth scrolling, and softer hover and dropdown animations, by @BarneyCompiler.
- The Mods tab of a pack is a table. From there you can use a newer release of a member in the instance made from the pack, also when you pinned it, and go back to the pack's version.
- A mod or pack you installed has a green check and an "Installed" chip on Discover.
- The buttons of a mod or pack page move below the title when the window is too narrow for them.
- On Windows, changing an instance no longer fails now and then with an "access denied" message.
- KSA 2026.10.10.5554 is a verified build.
- Mod authors: the listing editor shows the dependencies of your mod.toml and helps you add bounds, and it checks the members of a modpack as the index does.
- Mod authors: a fork or a SpaceDock mod can now prove that you own it, as the index accepts it.
- Stewards: a Steward entry in the navigation rail, released archives that are gone from their host on the Watcher tab, and release changes on the author's behalf.

Thank you, @BarneyCompiler, for your first contribution to Borea.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.5.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
